title.en: Roman Principate: emperors within republican forms
title.zh: 罗马元首制：共和形式下的皇帝

summary.en:
Augustus assembled durable personal power after the republic’s civil wars while retaining institutions such as the Senate. The resulting Principate was a political arrangement, not simply another name for the city of Rome. Emperors relied on armies, provincial administration, taxation and relationships with local elites across the Mediterranean. Imperial portraits and public buildings helped make this authority visible.

Provisioning cities and maintaining roads, ports and military settlements connected government to work and commerce. Provincial communities participated on unequal terms, and slavery remained part of the imperial economy. This overview connects the republic with the later imperial reorganization rather than treating every emperor as a separate timeline row. The selected endpoint marks Diocletian’s accession and a change of governing framework; it does not mean Roman institutions or provincial societies disappeared in 284.
summary.zh:
共和末期内战之后，奥古斯都在保留元老院等制度的同时，建立了持久的个人权力。由此形成的元首制是一种政治安排，并非罗马城的另一个名称。皇帝依靠军队、行省行政、税收和地方精英之间的关系治理地中海世界；皇帝肖像和公共建筑让权威获得可见形式。

城市供给以及道路、港口、军事聚落的维持，把政府与劳动和商业联系起来。行省群体参与帝国的条件并不平等，奴隶劳动也是帝国经济的一部分。本条把共和国与后来的帝国重组连接起来，不为每位皇帝设置年表行。284年是戴克里先即位及统治框架转变的节点，不表示罗马制度和行省社会在这一年消失。

dateNote.en: Focus: 27 BCE–284 CE, a conventional political phase; representative Rome point, not territorial extent.
dateNote.zh: 关注公元前27年至公元284年的传统政治分期；罗马点位不表示疆域。

title.en: Late Roman government and the western imperial endpoint
title.zh: 晚期罗马政府与西部帝位的终结

summary.en:
Diocletian’s reforms and the experiment of rule by several emperors addressed the problems of governing and defending a large empire. Constantine later reunited imperial power and established Constantinople as a new capital. These changes shifted the distribution of courts, military resources and religious patronage; they were not a simple movement of an unchanged capital from one city to another.

The western empire’s fifth-century troubles involved armies, rival courts, migration, warfare and the creation of new kingdoms. In 476 Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus, a conventional endpoint for the western imperial office. Roman law, Christianity, urban communities and administrative practices continued in different settings, while the eastern Roman government survived. Reading this political phase alongside provincial evidence helps distinguish an imperial deposition from the end of all Roman social life.
summary.zh:
戴克里先的改革与多皇帝共治实验，回应了治理和保卫大帝国的困难。君士坦丁后来重新集中帝权，并建立新都君士坦丁堡。这些变化重新配置宫廷、军力和宗教资助，并不是一个始终不变的首都从一城搬到另一城。

西部帝国在五世纪的困境涉及军队、竞争的宫廷、迁徙、战争与新王国的形成。476年，奥多亚塞废黜罗慕路斯·奥古斯都鲁斯，通常被用作西部帝位的终点。罗马法律、基督教、城市群体和行政做法仍在不同环境下延续，东部罗马政府也继续存在。把这一政治阶段与行省证据并读，有助于区分皇帝被废与整个罗马社会生活的终结。

dateNote.en: Focus: 284–476, with western government as the terminal reference; eastern continuity is shown separately. Ravenna is a representative later court.
dateNote.zh: 关注284—476年，终点指西部政府；东部延续另列。拉文纳是后期宫廷的代表点。

title.en: Holy Roman Empire: institutions across many territories
title.zh: 神圣罗马帝国：诸领地之间的制度

summary.en:
The Holy Roman Empire linked rulers, bishoprics, cities and other territories through an imperial office and a changing body of law. It was multilingual and decentralized; an elected emperor did not govern every territory as a provincial administrator. Imperial assemblies, courts and negotiated privileges gave this political order practical forms beyond coronations and dynastic portraits.

Religious division, territorial ambitions and the strength of princes reshaped the empire without immediately dissolving it. Habsburg hereditary lands overlapped with imperial politics but were not identical to the empire. The structure ended when Francis II relinquished the imperial crown in 1806. Using a single overview makes these institutional continuities legible while regional histories explain differences within them. Neither a modern German outline nor the ruler’s family possessions can substitute for the empire’s changing membership.
summary.zh:
神圣罗马帝国通过帝位和不断变化的法律，把诸侯、主教领、城市及其他领地联系起来。它具有多语言和分权特征；经选举产生的皇帝并不把所有领地都当作行省直接管理。帝国会议、法院及协商形成的特权，使这一政治秩序拥有加冕礼与王朝肖像之外的实际制度。

宗教分裂、领土诉求和诸侯力量不断改变帝国，却没有使它立即解体。哈布斯堡世袭领地与帝国政治重叠，但两者并不相同。1806年，弗朗茨二世放弃帝冠，这一结构走向终结。总览条目呈现制度延续，区域历史则解释内部差异。现代德国轮廓或统治者家族的全部领地，都不能替代不断变化的帝国成员范围。

title.en: Kyivan Rus’: Christian courts and connected crafts
title.zh: 基辅罗斯：基督教宫廷与工艺联系

location.label: Kyiv; representative princely and religious center

summary.en:
The acceptance of Christianity under Volodymyr in 988 connected Rus’ rulers and religious institutions with Byzantine models of worship, architecture and court display. Kyiv’s Saint Sophia and locally made precious-metal ornaments show that such connections involved adaptation as well as borrowing. Craftspeople produced objects for patrons whose identities and authority were expressed through dress and religious imagery.

This phase should not be read as one centralized state possessing fixed borders for two and a half centuries. It provides a political and cultural frame for a changing princely world, alongside other eastern European centers. The Mongol sack of Kyiv in 1240 marks the end of this entry’s focus, not the disappearance of its people or traditions. Its medieval legacy belongs to several later histories and cannot by itself settle modern national or territorial claims.
summary.zh:
988年弗拉基米尔（沃洛德米尔）接受基督教，使罗斯统治者及宗教机构与拜占庭的礼拜、建筑和宫廷展示方式建立联系。基辅圣索菲亚大教堂和当地制作的贵金属饰品表明，这种联系既包括借鉴，也包括改造。工匠为赞助者制作器物，服饰和宗教图像则表现身份与权威。

这一阶段不应被理解为一个拥有两个半世纪固定边界的中央集权国家。它为不断变化的诸王公世界提供政治和文化框架，并与其他东欧中心并列呈现。1240年蒙古军攻陷基辅，是本条关注阶段的终点，不是当地人群和传统的消失。中世纪遗产进入了多种后世历史，不能单独用来裁定现代民族或领土诉求。

title.en: Kalmar Union: one crown, several kingdoms
title.zh: 卡尔马联盟：一顶王冠与多个王国

summary.en:
At Kalmar in 1397, Denmark, Norway and Sweden agreed to share a monarch. Margaret’s political work and Eric of Pomerania’s coronation created a dynastic union whose participating kingdoms retained their own laws and customs. This arrangement joined political interests without making every jurisdiction identical.

Disagreements over appointments, taxation and royal authority produced repeated conflicts, especially in Sweden. Swedish participation was intermittent rather than an unbroken acceptance of central rule. The union therefore offers a useful comparison with other composite monarchies and with commercial networks around the Baltic. Its conventional endpoint in 1523 marks Sweden’s departure under Gustav Vasa, while other Scandinavian political connections continued. One timeline band can explain the union, but a single uniform national color would hide the negotiated and contested character of the arrangement.
summary.zh:
1397年，丹麦、挪威与瑞典在卡尔马同意共戴一位君主。玛格丽特的政治经营与波美拉尼亚的埃里克加冕，形成了一个王朝联盟；各王国仍保留自己的法律和习俗。这种安排把政治利益联系起来，却没有使所有辖区完全一致。

官职任命、税收和王权问题引发反复冲突，在瑞典尤其突出。瑞典参与联盟并非毫不中断地接受中央统治。因此，它适合与其他复合君主国及波罗的海商业网络比较。1523年的传统终点指瑞典在古斯塔夫·瓦萨领导下退出，其他斯堪的纳维亚政治联系仍然延续。年表中的一个区间可以解释联盟，但统一的民族国家色块会遮蔽其协商与争议并存的性质。

title.en: Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth: union and unequal citizenship
title.zh: 波兰立陶宛联邦：联合与不平等的政治参与

summary.en:
The Union of Lublin in 1569 established a closer political union between the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. A common elected monarch and parliament connected territories with different legal and administrative traditions. The surviving act makes negotiation and written constitutional arrangements visible as parts of state formation.

The Commonwealth’s republican vocabulary did not mean equal political power for every inhabitant. Noble privileges, urban interests, peasant obligations and religious diversity shaped unequal experiences of the same institutions. The Constitution of 3 May 1791 attempted reform as neighboring powers intervened. The partitions culminated in the Commonwealth’s disappearance in 1795, while its communities and political memories continued. Its overview links Baltic and eastern European histories without projecting modern Polish or Lithuanian borders backward onto an earlier, larger and internally varied political order.
summary.zh:
1569年的卢布林联合，使波兰王国与立陶宛大公国形成更紧密的政治联合。共同选举的君主和议会，把具有不同法律与行政传统的领地联系起来。保存下来的联合文书，让协商和成文宪制成为理解国家形成的具体证据。

联邦采用共和政治语言，并不表示每位居民都拥有同等权力。贵族特权、城市利益、农民义务与宗教差异，塑造了人们对同一制度的不平等体验。1791年五三宪法在邻国干涉的环境下尝试改革。瓜分最终使联邦于1795年消失，但其群体和政治记忆仍然延续。本条连接波罗的海与东欧历史，不把现代波兰或立陶宛边界投射到更早、更大且内部多样的政治秩序上。

title.en: Habsburg monarchy: a collection of crowns and laws
title.zh: 哈布斯堡君主国：多顶王冠与多种法律

summary.en:
Habsburg authority in central Europe grew through inheritance, marriage, election and war. Ferdinand’s acquisition of the Bohemian and Hungarian crowns in 1526 helped form a composite monarchy anchored in the Austrian hereditary lands. Possessing a crown did not ensure uncontested rule over every part of its claimed kingdom, particularly in lands contested with the Ottomans.

Different estates, languages and legal traditions persisted within the ruler’s domains. The dynasty’s imperial role in the Holy Roman Empire overlapped with, but was distinct from, these hereditary possessions. Political integration was a process of bargaining and administrative change rather than the instant creation of one uniform country. The Austrian imperial title adopted in 1804 provides this entry’s terminal transition. Reading the monarchy alongside Ottoman and regional histories clarifies how central Europe’s borders and institutions changed without reducing those histories to one dynasty’s family tree.
summary.zh:
哈布斯堡在中欧的权力通过继承、婚姻、选举和战争发展。1526年斐迪南取得波希米亚及匈牙利王冠，推动形成以奥地利世袭领地为基础的复合君主国。拥有王冠，并不表示对所声称王国的全部地区都能实施无争议统治，在与奥斯曼竞争的地区尤其如此。

统治者领地内仍保留不同的等级会议、语言和法律传统。王朝在神圣罗马帝国中的帝位，与这些世袭领地重叠，却并不相同。政治整合是一系列协商和行政变革，并非瞬间建立一个均质国家。1804年采用奥地利帝号，构成本条的阶段转折。把君主国与奥斯曼及各地区历史并读，有助于解释中欧边界和制度如何变化，而不把这些历史缩成一个家族的谱系。

title.en: Austria-Hungary: shared affairs and competing national claims
title.zh: 奥匈帝国：共同事务与竞争的民族诉求

location.label: Budapest; one of the dual monarchy’s governmental centers

summary.en:
The Compromise of 1867 reorganized Habsburg rule into an Austrian and a Hungarian half, each with its own government and parliament. The monarch and certain shared affairs connected them, while domestic policy followed different institutions. Vienna and Budapest therefore represent related centers of government rather than interchangeable capitals of a centralized nation-state.

The settlement privileged particular political elites without satisfying all the empire’s linguistic and national communities. Education, administration and public language could become matters of conflict as people sought rights and representation. The dual structure existed alongside economic and cultural connections that crossed its internal divisions. Its endpoint in 1918 belongs to the breakup of the monarchy at the end of the First World War. A political overview explains the constitutional arrangement; local histories are necessary to understand its unequal consequences for different populations.
summary.zh:
1867年的妥协把哈布斯堡统治重组为奥地利与匈牙利两部分，各有政府和议会。君主与若干共同事务把两部分联系起来，内政则由不同机构处理。因此，维也纳与布达佩斯是相互关联的政府中心，并非一个中央集权民族国家中可以互换的首都。

这一安排优待特定政治精英，却没有满足帝国内所有语言和民族群体。人们争取权利与代表权时，教育、行政和公共语言都可能成为冲突领域。二元结构同时伴随跨越内部分界的经济与文化联系。1918年的终点属于第一次世界大战结束时君主国的解体。政治总览能够解释宪制安排，而理解不同人群所承受的不平等后果，还需要地方历史。

title.en: Castile and Aragon: dynastic connection without instant merger
title.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡：王朝联系与不同制度

summary.en:
Ferdinand’s accession in Aragon in 1479 connected his crown with Isabella’s rule in Castile. Their marriage and joint political action strengthened royal authority, but the kingdoms were not instantly merged into a single uniform jurisdiction. The distinction matters when reading later Spanish imperial history backward through modern national boundaries.

The conquest of Granada in 1492, religious coercion and the expulsion of Jews transformed lives as well as royal power. Court patronage brought different artistic traditions together, while overseas voyages opened a further history of conquest and exploitation. Isabella’s death in 1504 and the succession that followed Ferdinand’s death in 1516 exposed the role of inheritance and regency. This overview connects the Nasrid entry with later Habsburg and Atlantic histories; it does not present territorial conquest or enforced religious conformity as consensual national unification.
summary.zh:
1479年斐迪南继承阿拉贡王位，使其王冠与伊莎贝拉在卡斯蒂利亚的统治联系起来。婚姻和共同政治行动强化了王权，但两个王国并未立即合并为制度一致的单一辖区。理解这一点，可以避免沿着现代国界倒读后来的西班牙帝国史。

1492年征服格拉纳达、宗教强制和驱逐犹太人，既改变了王权，也改变了人们的生活。宫廷资助汇集多种艺术传统，海外航行则开启另一段征服与剥削的历史。1504年伊莎贝拉去世，以及1516年斐迪南去世后的继承安排，显露出继承与摄政的重要性。本条连接纳斯里王朝、后来的哈布斯堡及大西洋历史，不把领土征服或强制宗教一致解释为各方自愿的民族统一。

title.en: Hedeby: trade, craft and a controlled crossing
title.zh: 海泽比：贸易、工艺与受控通道

summary.en:
Hedeby occupied a strategic position near the crossing between the North Sea and the Baltic. Its harbor, streets, workshops and cemeteries reveal a trading settlement connected with Scandinavian and continental societies. Nearby defensive works of the Danevirke show that commercial movement and political control developed together.

The archaeological evidence broadens a Viking-age narrative centered only on raiding. Crafts, shipping, exchange and urban households helped sustain a town through which people and goods passed. Imported objects establish connections, but they do not prove that every item traveled directly from its place of manufacture to Hedeby. This site complements the later Hanseatic example at Lübeck and the political history of Scandinavia. Its focus window selects the trading town’s Viking-age setting; the fortifications have a longer building history and the pin does not define a Viking people’s territorial boundary.
summary.zh:
海泽比位于北海与波罗的海之间的重要通道附近。港口、街道、工坊和墓地，展现了与斯堪的纳维亚及欧洲大陆社会相连的贸易聚落。邻近的丹尼维尔克防御工程表明，商业流动与政治控制共同发展。

考古材料扩展了只围绕劫掠展开的维京时代叙述。工艺、航运、交换和城市家庭共同维持这座人货往来的城镇。进口器物能够证明联系，却不能证明每件物品都从产地直达海泽比。本条与后来的吕贝克汉萨贸易及斯堪的纳维亚政治史相互补充。关注区间选取贸易城镇的维京时代环境；防御设施拥有更长的营建史，点位也不表示某个维京族群的领土边界。

title.en: Bologna: students organize a university
title.zh: 博洛尼亚：学生组织大学

summary.en:
Bologna’s teaching community developed gradually rather than through one securely documented founding ceremony. The university itself treats 1088 as a retrospective conventional date. Students who came to study law organized mutual-support associations, grouped by origins, that developed into larger corporate bodies known as universities.

These institutions were embedded in the city: teaching took place in rented spaces, homes and religious buildings, while students’ expenditure and legal privileges affected urban politics. The history therefore joins learning to housing, migration, patronage and authority. It also provides a comparison with religious and educational centers elsewhere in the atlas without claiming one universal path toward the modern university. Later changes to student autonomy and public employment of teachers show that a continuing institution could change its government. This focus ends around 1300 for the early corporate phase, not because Bologna’s university then ceased to exist.
summary.zh:
博洛尼亚的教学共同体逐步形成，并非源自一次有确证的创校仪式。大学自身把1088年视为后来确立的传统日期。前来学习法律的学生按来源组织互助团体，这些团体逐渐发展为被称作大学的更大法人组织。

这些机构嵌入城市生活：教学使用租赁空间、住宅和宗教建筑，学生消费与法律特权也影响城市政治。因此，求学史同时涉及住房、迁徙、资助与权威。它可以与本图其他宗教和教育中心比较，却不宣称各地都遵循通向现代大学的同一条道路。后来学生自治及教师公共雇佣方式的变化表明，机构在延续的同时也会改变治理结构。本条约止于1300年，是为了聚焦早期组织阶段，不表示博洛尼亚大学在那时结束。

dateNote.en: 1088 is a conventional commemorative founding year, not an independently established exact beginning; 1300 bounds this early-phase study.

title.en: Santiago routes: belief supported by roads and care
title.zh: 圣地亚哥巡礼路：道路与照护支持的信仰

summary.en:
Pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela connected a religious destination with towns and rural communities across several routes. Churches, bridges, hospitals and hostels sustained travel, making belief visible in infrastructure and everyday work. The tomb’s identification with the apostle James is a religious tradition; it is not presented here as a verified archaeological identity.

Pilgrims and hosts exchanged objects, skills and stories, while commerce supported settlements along the routes. The network was neither one road nor a documented itinerary followed by every traveler. Its surviving buildings also come from different periods, so a medieval focus cannot date each monument identically. This entry brings religion, mobility and care into the same history as royal power. The 1000–1500 window selects medieval development, while pilgrimage and the communities along its routes continue beyond that interval.
summary.zh:
前往圣地亚哥—德孔波斯特拉的巡礼，通过多条道路把宗教目的地与城市、乡村群体联系起来。教堂、桥梁、医院和旅舍支持旅行，使信仰体现为基础设施与日常劳动。墓葬被认作使徒雅各之墓属于宗教传统，本条不把它视为已经考古证实的身份。

巡礼者和接待者交换物品、技能与故事，商业活动也支持沿线聚落。这一网络既不是单一道路，也不是每位旅行者都遵循的有记录行程。现存建筑来自不同时代，因此不能用同一个中世纪日期标记每座建筑。本条把宗教、流动和照护纳入与王权并列的历史。1000—1500年用于选取中世纪发展阶段，巡礼及沿线群体在此后仍然延续。

dateNote.en: Focus: c.1000–1500 medieval development; routes originated earlier and continue later. Point marks the destination, not a drawn itinerary.

title.en: Huguenot refugees: escape, reception and livelihood
title.zh: 胡格诺难民：逃离、接纳与生计

location.label: Spitalfields, London; representative refugee settlement setting

summary.en:
The revocation of the Edict of Nantes in 1685 intensified the persecution of French Protestants and encouraged flight. Refugees reached England through dangerous and uneven journeys, then faced the practical work of securing shelter, support and employment. Community institutions and commercial connections helped some newcomers establish livelihoods, but a success story cannot stand for every refugee’s experience.

Isaac Minet’s account of detention, escape and settlement provides one documented case. Written decades after his arrival, it also shows how memory and religious conviction shaped a migrant’s narrative about his earlier life. His story should be compared with administrative records and other voices rather than treated as a complete demographic picture. The entry connects European religious conflict with craft, business and family history, and gives migration a place alongside the wars and treaties of the same period.
summary.zh:
1685年废除南特敕令，加剧了法国新教徒受到的迫害，并推动逃离。难民经过危险且各不相同的旅程抵达英格兰，随后必须寻找住所、援助与工作。共同体机构和商业联系帮助部分新来者建立生计，但成功故事不能代表所有难民的经验。

伊萨克·米内关于拘禁、逃亡与定居的叙述，是一个有记录的个案。该文写于抵达数十年后，也显示记忆与宗教信念如何塑造移民对早年生活的讲述。应将其与行政文书及其他声音比较，而不能视为完整人口图景。本条把欧洲宗教冲突与工艺、商业和家庭历史联系起来，使迁徙与同时期战争及条约并列进入历史。

title.en: Liverpool: docks, finance and the traffic in enslaved people
title.zh: 利物浦：船坞、融资与被奴役者的贩运

summary.en:
Liverpool’s eighteenth-century docks and commercial expansion were connected to the Atlantic economy and the trafficking of enslaved Africans. Parliamentary authorization and municipal finance helped enlarge port facilities. The first phase of dock building was completed in 1715, and later arrangements enabled further expansion through loans secured on local revenues.

This physical landscape was sustained by coercion as well as investment. Ships, merchants and manufactured goods connected the port with African and American societies, but the people transported as captives were not voluntary participants in a trading network. Reading the port alongside resistance, abolition and colonial labor histories gives infrastructure an ethical and social context. The endpoint of 1807 selects the British abolition of the slave trade; it did not instantly end slavery or remove the port’s connections with slave-produced commodities. No individual voyage or precise route is inferred from the existence of these links.
summary.zh:
利物浦十八世纪船坞与商业扩张，同大西洋经济及被奴役非洲人的贩运相联系。议会授权和市政融资推动港口设施扩大。首阶段船坞营建于1715年完成，后来的制度安排又使城市能够以地方收入担保借款，继续扩建。

这一物质景观既依靠投资，也依靠强制。船舶、商人和制成品把港口与非洲、美洲社会联系起来，但作为俘虏被运走的人，并不是自愿参与贸易网络。把港口与抵抗、废奴及殖民劳动史并读，才能为基础设施补充伦理和社会背景。1807年终点选取英国废止奴隶贸易的节点，并不表示奴隶制或港口与奴隶劳动产品的联系立即终结。仅凭这些联系，不推定任何个人航程或精确路线。

title.en: 1833: child labour rules acquire an inspectorate
title.zh: 1833年：童工法规建立监察制度

summary.en:
The 1833 Factory Act placed age and working-hour restrictions on children in specified textile factories and required schooling for younger workers. Its reach was limited: a statute about particular industries was not a ban on every form of child labor. Campaigns, inquiries and earlier legislation formed the background to the measure.

An inspectorate gave the government a new means of checking compliance, but four inspectors could not supervise thousands of mills continuously. Evasion therefore remained part of the law’s early history. This case shows why a reform’s passage and its effects on daily life need separate evidence. Children’s wages mattered to households, while employers and reformers disputed hours, education and industrial costs. Placing the act beside inventions and industrial landscapes keeps workers and institutions visible within the history of technological change.
summary.zh:
1833年《工厂法》对特定纺织工厂中儿童的年龄和工时设限，并要求较年幼工人接受教育。它的适用范围有限：针对某些行业的法规，并不等于禁止一切形式的童工。社会运动、调查和此前立法，共同构成这项措施的背景。

监察制度为政府提供了检查执行的新手段，但四名监察员无法持续监管数千家工厂，因此规避规定仍是该法早期历史的一部分。这个案例说明，改革通过与日常生活实际改变，需要分别寻找证据。儿童工资关系到家庭生计，雇主和改革者则争论工时、教育及工业成本。把法规与发明、工业景观并列，能使劳动者及制度在技术变迁史中保持可见。

title.en: 1848–1849: a parliament attempts German constitutional union
title.zh: 1848—1849年：议会尝试德国宪制联合

location.label: St Paul’s Church, Frankfurt am Main

summary.en:
The revolutionary upheavals of 1848 opened space for a German national assembly in Frankfurt. Representatives debated political rights, the shape of a proposed state and the relationship between a legislature and a monarch. Political clubs within the assembly expressed competing liberal, democratic and conservative programs rather than one agreed national will.

The project also exposed limits of representation: elections centered on adult independent men, with different procedures in different states. The assembly adopted fundamental rights and a constitution, but the Prussian king refused the imperial crown offered to him in 1849. Reviving monarchical power and military force defeated the constitutional project. Its failure was not an absence of political experimentation. Documents and debates allow comparison with later unification and constitutions, showing that national institutions could be proposed, contested and suppressed before a state possessing them actually existed.
summary.zh:
1848年的革命动荡，为法兰克福德国国民议会的召开打开空间。代表们讨论政治权利、拟议国家的形式，以及立法机关与君主的关系。议会内不同政治社团表达自由派、民主派和保守派的竞争方案，并非同一种已经形成的民族意志。

这一项目也显露代表制度的局限：选举围绕具有独立身份的成年男性展开，各邦程序不同。议会通过基本权利与宪法，但普鲁士国王在1849年拒绝所授帝冠。恢复力量的君主政府与军事行动，击败了宪制项目。失败不等于没有政治实验。文书与辩论可与后来的统一和宪法比较，说明在真正具备这些制度的国家出现之前，国家制度已可能被提出、争论并遭压制。

dateNote.en: 1848–1849 is the assembly/revolutionary focus, not a sovereign German state’s lifespan; constitutional adoption and implementation differed.

title.en: 1871: the Paris Commune and a divided city
title.zh: 1871年：巴黎公社与分裂的城市

summary.en:
After siege, defeat and an armistice in the Franco-Prussian War, conflict over authority within France produced the Paris Commune. Its brief experiment in municipal government ran from March to May 1871. Public debate and political participation involved workers, journalists, activists and women whose experiences cannot be reduced to the biographies of the movement’s best-known leaders.

Government forces retook Paris during the Bloody Week, with killings, imprisonment and destruction. Contemporary objects, portraits and photographs preserve evidence but also reflect accusation, propaganda and later remembrance. Even estimates of the death toll vary; this entry does not turn one contested number into a precise count. The Commune connects urban hardship, military power and arguments over social government. It also helps explain why later political movements returned to 1871 as an example, a warning or a symbol rather than agreeing on one shared interpretation.
summary.zh:
普法战争中的围城、战败和停战之后，法国国内围绕权威的冲突催生巴黎公社。其短暂的市政统治实验从1871年3月延续至5月。工人、记者、活动家和妇女参与公共讨论与政治行动，他们的经验不能缩减为几位知名领袖的传记。

政府军在“流血周”夺回巴黎，伴随杀戮、监禁和破坏。当时的器物、肖像与照片保存证据，也反映指控、宣传和后来的纪念。死亡人数估计仍有差异；本条不把某一争议数字当作精确统计。公社把城市困苦、军事实力与社会治理争论联系起来，也说明后来的政治运动为何不断把1871年视为典范、警示或象征，而非形成单一共识。

title.en: 1937: Gernika’s civilians and the making of Guernica
title.zh: 1937年：格尔尼卡平民与《格尔尼卡》的创作

summary.en:
On 26 April 1937 German and Italian aircraft attacked the Basque town of Gernika in support of the Nationalist side in the Spanish Civil War. Destruction, civilian suffering and reporting about the attack became part of an international conflict over the meaning of the war. A painting is not a casualty register, and estimates of deaths require their own evidence.

The attack helped prompt Picasso’s Guernica, made for the Spanish Republic’s pavilion at the Paris exhibition. Images, reports, preparatory drawings and exhibition documents show how an event became an internationally circulating political symbol. The work’s subsequent journeys and reception should be distinguished from eyewitness evidence about the bombing itself. Linking civilian experience with art and propaganda gives the Spanish conflict a place within the atlas without treating it merely as a prelude to the Second World War.
summary.zh:
1937年4月26日，德国和意大利飞机为支持西班牙内战中的国民军一方，袭击巴斯克城镇格尔尼卡。破坏、平民苦难及有关报道，进入围绕战争意义展开的国际争论。绘画并非死伤登记，死亡人数估计需要独立证据。

袭击推动毕加索创作《格尔尼卡》，用于西班牙共和国的巴黎博览会展馆。图像、报道、草图和展览文书，显示一个事件如何成为跨国流传的政治象征。作品此后的旅行与接受史，应与轰炸本身的目击证据区别。把平民经验与艺术、宣传联系起来，可使西班牙冲突进入本图，而不只把它视作第二次世界大战的前奏。

title.en: 1956: Hungarian revolt, workers and Soviet intervention
title.zh: 1956年：匈牙利起义、工人与苏联干预

summary.en:
Demonstrations and armed conflict in Hungary in October 1956 brought together students, workers and other participants with different expectations of political change. The uprising challenged domestic repression and Hungary’s subordinate relationship with the Soviet Union. It cannot be explained only through the actions of one leader or as a contest directed entirely from abroad.

The Soviet assault on 4 November crushed the attempt to change the political order. Subsequent repression and displacement shaped lives beyond the days of fighting. Declassified records also expose uncertainty and mistaken expectations among foreign governments, warning against assuming that later outcomes were obvious to contemporaries. This episode connects industrial workers and civic mobilization with the political map of Cold War Europe. Government reports and retrospective documentary collections are used with attention to who produced them and to the differences between observation, interpretation and official justification.
summary.zh:
1956年10月匈牙利的示威和武装冲突，汇集了对政治变化抱有不同期待的学生、工人及其他参与者。起义挑战国内镇压，以及匈牙利对苏联的从属关系。它不能仅由一位领袖的行动解释，也不能被缩为完全受境外指挥的对抗。

11月4日苏联进攻，压制了改变政治秩序的尝试。其后的镇压和流离失所，使影响超出战斗持续的日子。解密文书也暴露外国政府的不确定与错误预期，提醒我们不要把后来结局视为当时人早已知道的事实。此事件把工业劳动者、公民动员与冷战欧洲政治地图相连。使用政府报告和回顾性文献集时，需要关注制作者，并区分观察、解释与官方辩解。

title.en: 1968: Prague Spring, censorship and resistance on air
title.zh: 1968年：布拉格之春、审查与广播抵抗

location.label: Czechoslovak Radio, Prague; representative testimony setting

summary.en:
The Prague Spring opened a period of reform and debate within socialist Czechoslovakia in 1968. Changes in censorship allowed journalists and citizens to discuss subjects that earlier controls had restricted. The movement’s participants did not all seek the same political destination, and reform within socialism should not be equated automatically with a fully formed later constitutional order.

Soviet-led Warsaw Pact troops invaded in August. Radio staff continued news broadcasts from improvised locations after troops occupied their main building, leaving testimony about both coercion and civilian action. Such recollections are evidence of particular experiences rather than a view of every street or institution. The invasion and subsequent restrictions connect the episode with later dissent, including Charter 77 and Václav Havel’s activities. This entry follows communication and everyday political agency alongside the decisions of governments and armies.
summary.zh:
1968年的布拉格之春，在社会主义捷克斯洛伐克内部开启改革与讨论。审查制度的变化，使记者和公民得以谈论过去受到限制的话题。参与者并非都追求同一种政治结果，社会主义内部改革也不能自动等同于后来已经成形的宪制秩序。

8月，苏联领导的华约军队入侵。主要广播大楼被占领后，电台人员仍从临时地点播发新闻，留下关于强制与平民行动的证言。这些回忆证明特定经验，并不代表每条街道或所有机构。入侵及其后限制，与后来的异议活动，包括七七宪章及瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔的行动相联系。本条在政府和军队决策之外，也追踪传播与日常政治能动性。

title.en: Solidarity: workplace organization and negotiated change
title.zh: 团结工会：工作场所组织与协商变革

summary.en:
Strikes and the August 1980 agreements opened the way for Solidarity, an independent self-governing trade union in Poland. Organization at workplaces became connected with wider claims about rights, public life and political accountability. The movement included more people and interests than its best-known leaders alone can represent.

Martial law imposed in December 1981 brought arrests, repression and underground activity. Printing, mutual aid, youth groups and support from abroad helped sustain forms of association outside official control. The 1989 Round Table negotiations and partially free elections were a later transition, not the immediate outcome of the first strikes. Exhibitions preserve objects and testimony while also presenting a commemorative interpretation of the movement. Linking labour organization with these changing institutions makes Poland’s political transformation intelligible beyond the single date of a border or government change.
summary.zh:
罢工与1980年8月协议，为波兰独立自治的团结工会开辟道路。工作场所的组织活动，与关于权利、公共生活和政治问责的更广泛诉求相联系。运动包含的人群和利益，超出几位知名领袖能够代表的范围。

1981年12月实施戒严，带来逮捕、镇压与地下活动。印刷、互助、青年团体及境外支持，使官方控制之外的结社形式得以维持。1989年圆桌谈判和部分自由选举，是后来的转折，并非最初罢工的即时结果。展览保存器物和证言，同时也表达对运动的纪念性解释。把劳工组织与制度变化相连，能使波兰政治转型超出边界或政府改变的单一日期。

dateNote.en: 1980–1989 selects the agreements-to-election transition; Solidarity’s institutional history continues afterward. 1989 elections were partially free.

title.en: West Germany: recruited workers become settled communities
title.zh: 西德：招募劳工与定居群体的形成

summary.en:
West German recruitment agreements beginning with Italy in 1955 brought workers to an expanding economy. Later agreements included Turkey and several other countries. The label Gastarbeiter, or guest workers, expressed an expectation of temporary labor, while actual lives involved difficult jobs, shared accommodation, family decisions and relationships with employers and neighbors.

Some migrants returned, while others settled and reunited with family members. Their work and presence became part of postwar German society rather than an external footnote to economic recovery. The 1973 recruitment stop for workers from outside the European Community did not remove existing communities or end migration. Comparing recruitment policy with workers’ experiences shows the distance between an official program and its social consequences. This focus complements constitutional and reunification records by following people whose daily lives crossed the political categories used in national histories.
summary.zh:
西德从1955年与意大利签订招工协议开始，为扩张中的经济引入劳工。后来协议包括土耳其及其他多个国家。“客工”一词表达了临时劳动的预期，实际生活却涉及艰苦岗位、集体宿舍、家庭决定，以及与雇主、邻居的关系。

部分移民返回原居地，另一些则定居并与家人团聚。他们的劳动与存在成为战后德国社会的一部分，而非经济复苏之外的附注。1973年停止从欧洲共同体以外国家招工，并没有使既有群体消失，也没有结束迁徙。把招募政策与工人经验比较，能看到官方方案及其社会后果之间的距离。本条通过追踪跨越民族史政治分类的日常生活，补充宪制与重新统一条目。

title.en: 1995: Srebrenica, forced removal and genocide
title.zh: 1995年：斯雷布雷尼察、强制迁移与种族灭绝

summary.en:
In July 1995 Bosnian Serb forces took Srebrenica during the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Bosnian Muslim men and boys were separated, detained and murdered, while women, children and other residents were forcibly removed. The crimes destroyed families and communities; the history cannot be represented adequately as a neutral change of territorial color.

International criminal investigations assembled testimony, forensic evidence and records about the killings and displacement. Judicial findings established genocide, and later identification and remembrance concern people as well as legal categories. This entry draws on court and United Nations accounts while avoiding claims that every victim’s fate or every individual’s responsibility can be summarized by one paragraph. It connects the broader Yugoslav succession entry with a specific experience of civilian targeting. The locality pin identifies a historical setting, not all execution, detention or burial sites.
summary.zh:
1995年7月，在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那战争期间，波斯尼亚塞族部队占领斯雷布雷尼察。波斯尼亚穆斯林男性和男孩被分离、拘禁并杀害，妇女、儿童及其他居民则遭强制移走。罪行摧毁家庭与群体，不能仅以中性的领土换色来表达。

国际刑事调查汇集有关杀戮与迁移的证言、法医证据和文书。司法裁判认定种族灭绝；后来的身份确认与纪念既涉及法律类别，也涉及具体的人。本条采用法庭和联合国资料，但不宣称一个段落能够总结每位受害者的命运或每个人的责任。它把更广泛的南斯拉夫继承国家条目，与平民遭到针对的具体经验相连。点位表示历史环境，并非所有处决、拘禁或埋葬地点。

title.en: Hildegard of Bingen · Community, correspondence and knowledge
title.zh: 宾根的希尔德加德 · 团体、书信与知识

summary.en:
Hildegard led a religious community in the twelfth-century Rhineland and produced theological, musical and natural-philosophical writings. Her authority emerged within monastic institutions, patronage and correspondence rather than outside social structures. Letters linked her with religious leaders and rulers, offering evidence of how a woman could intervene in public and ecclesiastical debate.

Around 1150 she moved her community to Rupertsberg near Bingen and later founded another house across the Rhine. Such activity required attention to material resources and communal organization as well as spiritual teaching. Her visionary language belongs to the history of belief and authorship; the atlas does not treat supernatural claims as empirical medical evidence. Reading her alongside universities and political institutions shows several different settings in which medieval knowledge was made and circulated. The surviving letters also leave gaps: they are selected exchanges, not a complete diary or a surveyed travel itinerary.
summary.zh:
希尔德加德在十二世纪莱茵地区领导宗教团体，并创作神学、音乐及自然哲学著述。她的权威形成于修道制度、资助关系和书信往来之中，而非脱离社会结构。她与宗教领袖和统治者通信，留下女性如何介入公共及教会争论的证据。

约1150年，她把团体迁至宾根附近鲁佩茨贝格，后来又在莱茵河对岸建立另一所修院。这些行动不仅涉及精神教导，也需要物质资源与群体组织。她的异象语言属于信仰与写作史；本图不把超自然说法当作经验医学证据。将其与大学和政治机构并读，能看到中世纪知识形成、流通的多种环境。现存书信也有空缺：它们是选择性交流，并非完整日记或经过测绘的行程。

title.en: Christine de Pizan · Writing women into a learned world
title.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·德·皮桑 · 在知识世界书写女性

location.label: Paris; representative literary and courtly setting

summary.en:
Christine de Pizan made writing and book production a livelihood within the courtly world of late medieval France. Widowhood and responsibility for her household formed part of this history, alongside patronage, copying and illumination. Her works were material books made with collaborators and presented to readers who could support their production.

The Book of the City of Ladies answered hostile representations of women through an allegorical construction populated by exemplary figures. The Book of the Three Virtues offered instruction to women in different social positions. These projects should be read in their medieval moral and hierarchical setting rather than treated as a direct statement of every modern political position. Manuscript copies reveal circulation and adaptation, while gaps in the record make some biographical dates approximate. Her entry connects intellectual argument with the economic and collaborative work of making books before printing transformed their distribution.
summary.zh:
克里斯蒂娜·德·皮桑在法国中世纪晚期宫廷世界中，以写作和制作书籍维持生计。守寡、家庭责任，以及资助、抄写和绘饰共同构成这段历史。她的作品是与合作者制作的物质书籍，并呈献给能够支持制作的读者。

《女性之城》通过由典范人物组成的寓言城市，回应对女性的敌意描写。《三德之书》则向不同社会位置的女性提供教导。应把这些项目放回中世纪道德与等级环境，而非当作所有现代政治立场的直接表达。手抄本显示作品的流传与改写，史料空缺也使部分生平日期只能约定。她的条目把思想论辩与印刷改变传播方式之前的经济及协作劳动联系起来。

title.en: Nicolaus Copernicus · Reworking the order of the planets
title.zh: 尼古拉·哥白尼 · 重构行星秩序

location.label: Frombork; representative chapter and astronomical setting

summary.en:
Copernicus combined astronomical work with education in law and medicine and duties connected to a cathedral chapter. His learning moved through several European institutions; a doctorate in canon law at Ferrara in 1503 belonged to a career broader than the familiar image of a solitary observer. This setting links astronomy to ecclesiastical employment and scholarly exchange.

De revolutionibus, published in 1543, placed the Earth among planets moving around the Sun. The mathematical system still used circular motions and was not identical to modern orbital mechanics. Its publication therefore marks a proposal and a new framework for argument, not the immediate conversion of every observer or authority. Later work by astronomers and natural philosophers changed both its evidence and its mathematical form. Reading Copernicus alongside Galileo and learned institutions explains scientific change as a process of criticism, measurement and revision rather than a single discovery that instantly settled every question.
summary.zh:
哥白尼把天文学工作，与法律、医学教育及教堂参事会相关职责结合起来。他的学习经过欧洲多所机构；1503年在费拉拉取得教会法博士学位，属于一个比“孤独观测者”形象更广的职业生涯。这一环境把天文学与教会雇佣、学术交流联系起来。

1543年出版的《天体运行论》，把地球放在围绕太阳运动的行星之列。但其数学体系仍使用圆周运动，并不等同于现代轨道力学。出版因此标志一种方案与新的论争框架，不表示所有观测者或权威立即接受。后来的天文学家和自然哲学家改变了其证据与数学形式。将哥白尼与伽利略、学术机构并读，能够把科学变化理解为批评、测量和修正的过程，而非一次发现瞬间解决全部问题。

title.en: Maria Sibylla Merian · Insects, images and colonial knowledge
title.zh: 玛丽亚·西比拉·梅里安 · 昆虫、图像与殖民知识

location.label: Amsterdam; representative studio and publication setting

summary.en:
Merian joined artistic training to sustained observation of insects and their food plants. Rearing larvae and recording stages of development made her illustrations arguments about relationships and change, not merely decorative pictures. The work also depended on studios, printmaking, collectors and the collaboration of her daughters.

She traveled with Dorothea to Dutch Suriname in 1699 and returned in 1701; the resulting book appeared in 1705. Indigenous and enslaved people contributed knowledge within a colonial society structured by unequal power. Their participation should remain visible beside the European author’s name, while specific observations still require scrutiny rather than automatic acceptance. Merian’s career links European markets and publishing with American environments and coerced labor. The Amsterdam pin represents an important working center; it does not collapse a transatlantic life into one place or infer an exact surveyed itinerary from the existence of a voyage.
summary.zh:

1699年，她与多萝西娅前往荷属苏里南，1701年返回，相关著作于1705年出版。在权力不平等的殖民社会中，原住民和被奴役者贡献了知识；他们的参与应与欧洲作者姓名一起保持可见，具体观察也仍需审查，而非自动接受。梅里安的生涯把欧洲市场和出版，与美洲环境及强制劳动联系起来。阿姆斯特丹点位代表重要工作中心，不把跨大西洋人生缩成一地，也不因航行存在就推定经过测绘的精确行程。

title.en: Mary Wollstonecraft · Education, dependence and rights
title.zh: 玛丽·沃斯通克拉夫特 · 教育、依附与权利

location.label: London; representative writing and publishing setting

summary.en:
Wollstonecraft argued that women’s apparent dependence should be examined through education, social expectations and material relationships. Her political writing belonged to debates about virtue, commercial society and the French Revolution, not only to a later history of voting rights. Criticism of inherited privilege and the condition of women formed connected parts of her thought.

A Vindication of the Rights of Woman appeared in 1792. It challenged forms of education that cultivated display and dependence rather than reason and responsibility. The work’s later reception changed: private-life controversy affected her reputation, while readers in different countries returned to her arguments for their own purposes. Her biography connects authorship and intellectual labor with questions about family, livelihood and citizenship. It does not assume that an eighteenth-century writer anticipated every position later associated with feminism, or that publication itself produced equal rights for her contemporaries.
summary.zh:
沃斯通克拉夫特主张，应通过教育、社会期待和物质关系来考察女性表现出的依附状态。她的政治写作属于关于德性、商业社会及法国革命的争论，而不只是后来投票权历史的一部分。批评世袭特权与分析女性处境，是其思想中相互联系的内容。

《女权辩护》于1792年出版，挑战培养装饰性表现与依附、却不培养理性和责任的教育方式。作品的接受后来发生变化：私生活争议影响声誉，不同国家的读者又为各自目的重读其论证。她的传记把写作及知识劳动，与家庭、生计和公民身份联系起来。本条不假定十八世纪作者已经预见后来所有女性主义立场，也不把出版等同于同时代女性立即取得平等权利。

title.en: Florence Nightingale · Care, numbers and institutions
title.zh: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔 · 照护、数字与机构

location.label: St Thomas’ Hospital, London; training-school reference

summary.en:
Nightingale’s work joined nursing, hospital organization and statistical argument. During the Crimean War she worked with other nurses at Scutari, confronting inadequate care and institutional conflict. Later analysis and diagrams helped her argue for changes in sanitary conditions and hospital practice. The familiar lamp image captures only one part of a career that also involved records, administration and persuasion.

The training school established at St Thomas’ Hospital in 1860 helped make organized nursing education an enduring institution. Reform depended on the work of many nurses, supporters and hospital staff, so her biography is not a claim that one person alone created modern care. Reading her beside factory regulation and scientific institutions shows different ways that evidence and organized labor could enter public debate. Historical health claims here describe her activities and arguments; they are not offered as present-day clinical guidance.
summary.zh:
南丁格尔的工作把护理、医院组织和统计论证结合起来。克里米亚战争期间，她与其他护士在斯库台工作，面对不足的照护和机构冲突。后来的分析与图表帮助她争取卫生条件及医院实践的改变。熟悉的提灯形象，只呈现这个同时涉及记录、行政和说服的职业生涯的一部分。

1860年在圣托马斯医院建立的培训学校，使有组织的护理教育形成持久机构。改革依靠众多护士、支持者和医院人员的劳动，因此本条不宣称一人独自创造现代照护。把她与工厂监管及科学机构并读，可以看到证据和有组织劳动介入公共讨论的不同方式。这里的历史卫生说法用于描述她的行动和论证，并非当代临床建议。

title.en: Lise Meitner · Exile and the interpretation of fission
title.zh: 莉泽·迈特纳 · 流亡与裂变的解释

location.label: Stockholm; representative exile and research setting

summary.en:
Meitner built a career in radiation physics through study, laboratory collaboration and university work. Nazi persecution forced her to flee Germany in 1938. Exile disrupted an established working environment, but correspondence with Otto Hahn continued as experiments produced unexpected chemical results.

Meitner and her nephew Otto Frisch supplied a physical interpretation of nuclear splitting, published in 1939. Their contribution must be distinguished from Hahn and Fritz Strassmann’s experimental chemical findings rather than assigning every part of the discovery to a single person. Later recognition, including the Nobel award to Hahn alone, illustrates how attribution can differ from the collaborative production of knowledge. Her biography connects European intellectual migration, exclusion and scientific institutions without treating the subsequent development of nuclear weapons as the inevitable intention of every researcher involved. Surviving letters offer evidence of uncertainty and reasoning as discoveries unfolded.
summary.zh:
迈特纳通过学习、实验室协作和大学工作，建立辐射物理研究生涯。纳粹迫害迫使她于1938年逃离德国。流亡打断既有工作环境，但随着实验出现意外化学结果，她与奥托·哈恩的通信仍然继续。

迈特纳与外甥奥托·弗里施提出原子核分裂的物理解释，并于1939年发表。应将其贡献与哈恩及弗里茨·施特拉斯曼的化学实验发现区分，而非把发现的每一部分都归给一人。后来仅向哈恩颁发诺贝尔奖等认可方式，说明成果归属可能不同于知识的协作生产。她的传记把欧洲知识迁徙、排斥和科学机构相连，不把后来核武器的发展视为每位研究者必然具有的意图。现存书信保存发现过程中不确定与推理的证据。

title.en: Irena Sendler · Rescue through a network of care
title.zh: 伊雷娜·森德勒 · 照护网络中的救援

summary.en:
Sendler used her work in Warsaw’s welfare system to help Jews under German occupation. Entering the ghetto, finding hiding places and arranging support required cooperation with Jewish activists, other rescuers, institutions and households. Children’s survival depended on a network rather than the actions of one heroic individual alone.

In 1943 she led the children’s section of Żegota, the underground Council for Aid to Jews. Arrest and torture did not end her work after others secured her release. She preserved information about children’s identities and placements, linking rescue with the hope of recovering family ties after the war. Yad Vashem recognized her in 1965. The exact number saved by Sendler and her partners is unknown, so the entry avoids a popular precise total. Her story complements the Holocaust overview by following practical care, danger and cooperation while keeping the persecuted children and their families central.
summary.zh:
森德勒利用在华沙福利系统中的工作，帮助德国占领下的犹太人。进入隔都、寻找藏身处和安排援助，需要与犹太活动家、其他救援者、机构及家庭合作。儿童生存依靠一个网络，并非某位英雄个人独自行动的结果。

1943年，她领导地下援犹委员会“热戈塔”的儿童部门。遭逮捕和酷刑后，其他人设法使其获释，她仍继续工作。她保存儿童原有身份与安置地点的信息，把救援与战后恢复家庭联系的希望相连。以色列大屠杀纪念馆于1965年表彰她。森德勒及同伴救出的人数无法精确确定，因此本条不采用流传甚广的精确总数。她的故事通过照护、危险与合作补充大屠杀总览，同时把受迫害儿童及其家庭置于中心。

title.en: Václav Havel · Theatre, dissent and constitutional office
title.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔 · 戏剧、异议与宪制职位

location.label: Prague; representative theatre and political setting

summary.en:
Havel’s career linked theatre and public argument to organized dissent in communist Czechoslovakia. Restrictions on publication and repeated imprisonment shaped the conditions under which he wrote. Charter 77, for which he served as one of the first spokespersons, joined particular people in a rights-based initiative; it was not simply another name for the whole population’s political views.

In November 1989 he became a leading representative of Civic Forum, and the Federal Assembly elected him president on 29 December. He later became the first president of the separate Czech Republic. The transition from dissident writer to office-holder raises questions about institutions, compromise and the responsibilities of governing, not only personal moral reputation. His plays, essays, documents and the testimony of others provide different kinds of evidence. This biography connects the Prague Spring, later civic mobilization and the constitutional changes already represented elsewhere in the atlas.
summary.zh:
哈维尔的生涯把戏剧与公共论辩，同共产主义捷克斯洛伐克的有组织异议联系起来。出版限制和反复入狱，塑造了其写作条件。他担任七七宪章最初发言人之一；这项以权利为基础的行动联系特定参与者，并不等于全体人口政治观点的另一个名称。

1989年11月，他成为公民论坛的重要代表，联邦议会于12月29日选举他为总统。后来，他成为独立捷克共和国的首任总统。从异议作家到任职者的转变，提出关于制度、妥协和治理责任的问题，而不只是个人道德声望。戏剧、散文、文书及其他人的证言，提供不同类型的证据。本传记连接布拉格之春、后来的公民动员，以及本图其他条目已呈现的宪制变化。

title.en: Rosa Luxemburg · Labour, war and contested revolution
title.zh: 罗莎·卢森堡 · 劳工、战争与有争议的革命

location.label: Berlin; representative political and publishing setting

summary.en:
Luxemburg’s life crossed the imperial boundaries of Poland, Switzerland and Germany. Study in Zurich led to a doctorate in economics, while organizing and journalism connected her with socialist movements. Her arguments about strikes, capitalism and political organization emerged from debates within those movements rather than a single doctrine shared by every socialist.

She opposed the First World War and spent years in prison. The upheavals of 1918 brought her back into public political work, including participation in the foundation of the German Communist Party. She also criticized restrictions on political freedom in revolutionary government, showing that support for social transformation did not eliminate disagreement about how it should occur. Soldiers murdered her in Berlin in January 1919. Her biography connects working-class politics, intellectual labor and violence while distinguishing her own writings from later commemorative portrayals that have claimed her as a symbol.
summary.zh:
卢森堡的人生跨越波兰、瑞士与德国的帝国边界。在苏黎世学习使她取得经济学博士学位，组织与新闻写作则把她同社会主义运动联系起来。关于罢工、资本主义和政治组织的论证，形成于运动内部争论，并非所有社会主义者共享的单一教条。

她反对第一次世界大战，并多年入狱。1918年的动荡使其重回公开政治活动，包括参与创建德国共产党。她也批评革命政府限制政治自由，说明支持社会改造并不消除对实现方式的分歧。1919年1月，军人在柏林杀害她。本传记把工人政治、知识劳动与暴力相连，并区分她本人的文字，与后来将其视为象征的纪念性描写。
